description: Dataset-specialized JSONL codec for the Yelp business corpus. Single skeleton template + per-column dictionaries: 6-bit packed business ids, sorted-unique zstd string pools (name/address), Huffman-coded dictionary ids with adjacent-repeat run bits (city/state/postal/review_count), scaled-integer sorted dictionaries for latitude/longitude with exact digit re-rendering, attribute objects decomposed into per-(key,value) combo strings indexed by u16 pair ids with adjacent-repeat run bits, category token-dictionary rendering, hours day-mask + Huffman time-string ids.
name: yelp-jsonl-combo
